title: Thermal barrier material marking.
officialText:
Insulating materials utilized in thermal barriers shall be installed such that the
manufacturer’s R-value mark is readily observable upon inspection.
SECTION MC 1210
HIGH-PRESSURE STEAM AND HIGH TEMPERATURE HOT WATER PIPING SYSTEMS
